They have expertise in utilizing TCP/IP utilities for diagnostics, implementing geographic information systems (GIS) using ArcGIS software, and supporting a wide array of operating systems including Windows Server 2016, 2012, 2003, 2000, as well as Linux variants like HP Unix. The candidate's technological versatility is evident from managing Hyper-V clusters to overseeing the implementation of Alertus Desktop alerting and Ghost imaging for computer management.
